\[
\begin{aligned}
\int \arcsin\sqrt{\frac{x}{a+x}}\,dx
&\overset{\text{分部积分}}{=} x\arcsin\sqrt{\frac{x}{a+x}} - \frac{\sqrt{a}}{2}\int\frac{\sqrt{x}}{a+x}\,dx \\[6pt]
&\overset{t=\sqrt{x}}{=} x\arcsin\sqrt{\frac{x}{a+x}} - \sqrt{a}\int\frac{t^2}{a+t^2}\,dt \\[6pt]
&= x\arcsin\sqrt{\frac{x}{a+x}} - \sqrt{a}\int\left(1-\frac{a}{a+t^2}\right)\,dt \\[6pt]
&= x\arcsin\sqrt{\frac{x}{a+x}} - \sqrt{a}\,t + a\arctan\frac{t}{\sqrt{a}} + C \\[6pt]
&\overset{t=\sqrt{x}}{=} x\arcsin\sqrt{\frac{x}{a+x}} - \sqrt{ax} + a\arctan\sqrt{\frac{x}{a}} + C.
\end{aligned}
\]

又令 $\theta=\arcsin\sqrt{\frac{x}{a+x}}$，则 $\sin\theta=\sqrt{\frac{x}{a+x}}$，且
\[
\cos\theta = \sqrt{1-\sin^2\theta} = \sqrt{1-\frac{x}{a+x}} = \sqrt{\frac{a}{a+x}}.
\]
因此
\[
\tan\theta = \frac{\sin\theta}{\cos\theta} = \frac{\sqrt{\dfrac{x}{a+x}}}{\sqrt{\dfrac{a}{a+x}}} = \sqrt{\frac{x}{a}},
\]
从而
\[
\arctan\sqrt{\frac{x}{a}} = \theta = \arcsin\sqrt{\frac{x}{a+x}}.
\]

所以
\[
\begin{aligned}
\int \arcsin\sqrt{\frac{x}{a+x}}\,dx
&= x\arcsin\sqrt{\frac{x}{a+x}} - \sqrt{ax} + a\arcsin\sqrt{\frac{x}{a+x}} + C \\[6pt]
&= \boxed{(a+x)\arcsin\sqrt{\frac{x}{a+x}} - \sqrt{ax} + C}.
\end{aligned}
